description: Defines data structures, constants, and functions related to Control Resource Sets (CORESETs) in 5G NR, including configuration, identifiers, and resource calculations.

classes.name: coreset_configuration
classes.description: Represents the configuration of a CORESET, including parameters like ID, frequency resources, duration, interleaving, and scrambling ID.

methods.name: coreset_configuration::get_coreset0_index
methods.description: Returns the optional index for CORESET#0.

methods.name: coreset_configuration::duration
methods.description: Returns the duration of the CORESET in symbols.

methods.name: coreset_configuration::get_pdcch_dmrs_scrambling_id
methods.description: Returns the optional PDCCH DMRS scrambling ID.

methods.name: coreset_configuration::set_non_coreset0_duration
methods.description: Sets the duration for non-CORESET#0 configurations.

methods.name: coreset_configuration::set_non_coreset0_interleaved
methods.description: Sets the interleaving parameters for non-CORESET#0.

methods.name: coreset_configuration::set_non_coreset0_precoder_granularity
methods.description: Sets the precoder granularity for non-CORESET#0.

methods.name: coreset_configuration::set_non_coreset0_pdcch_dmrs_scrambling_id
methods.description: Sets the PDCCH DMRS scrambling ID for non-CORESET#0.

methods.name: coreset_configuration::coreset0_crbs
methods.description: Returns the CRB interval for CORESET#0.

methods.name: coreset_configuration::set_freq_domain_resources
methods.description: Sets the frequency resource bitmap for the CORESET.

methods.name: coreset_configuration::get_nof_cces
methods.description: Calculates the number of CCEs based on configuration.

methods.name: coreset_configuration::get_coreset_start_crb
methods.description: Calculates the lowest CRB index used by the CORESET.
